'''July 2001 Moorestown tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in WOTC store, Moorestown Mall, Moorestown, NJ on 22 July 2001. [[Greg Hodur]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2700">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-moorestown-nj-22-jul-01d2700/ moorestown-nj-22-jul-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 23 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-moorestown-nj-22-jul-01d2700/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 July 2001
* '''Site:''' WOTC store, Moorestown Mall, Moorestown, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Greg Hodur]]
